entries.body: Tidewater Advisory LLC runs one Microsoft 365 tenant in the government community cloud (GCC) with 162 user accounts. entries.body: Licences: Microsoft 365 G5 (GCC), 27 of 30 seats consumed; Copilot for Microsoft 365 (GCC), 3 of 10; two add-on SKUs (Dataverse capacity, Power Virtual Agents) with no seats consumed. The tenant's service plans include Entra ID premium (P2) and Defender for Office 365.

entries.body: Three users hold privileged roles, eight privileged roles in all; two of the three are Global Administrators, which gives a least-privilege score of 2 (two Global Administrators to one privileged user without the role). All three are cloud-only accounts.

entries.body: Six Conditional Access policies, all enabled: a legacy-authentication block that excludes one user; blocks for high user risk and for high sign-in risk; an MFA authentication-strength requirement for all users (not the phishing-resistant strength); a device-code block that excludes one user and one group; and a session policy (sign-in every 4 days, no persistent browser session). No policy requires phishing-resistant MFA, requires managed devices, or blocks risky AI agents.
